name: Creality Falcon T1 60W MOPA
tagline: 60W MOPA module: color stainless and deeper metal on the T1 galvo
tldr: The 60W MOPA WaveSync head is Creality's top metal module for Falcon T1: pulse control for color effects on stainless and faster deep engraving than the 20W fiber option. For shops that already committed to the T1 chassis and need production metal throughput.
mainObjective: MOPA fiber marking with color effects on the T1 modular platform

priceRange.note: Official Creality store, Oct 2026: $4,299, complete machine

engraveExample.description: Deep logo on stainless steel plate

pros: Pulse control for colour marks on stainless and black marks on anodised aluminium
Most powerful metal module on the T1: the fastest deep engraving in our benchmark
Fine spot (about 0.02 mm) for detailed metal work
cons: Most expensive T1 option: $4,299 bundle or $2,699 alone (October 2026)
Colour marking takes test grids and time to dial in for each material
No cutting of wood, leather or acrylic
beginnerNotes: This profile is the 60W SKU on Creality Falcon T1 MOPA. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks above, then compare other modules via the chips before buying.
proTips: Budget MOPA plus chassis plus diode module together before committing: total can exceed fixed F2 Ultra bundles.
primaryUse: 60W MOPA fiber module for advanced metal marking on the Falcon T1 galvo chassis.

moduleSystem.headline: WaveSync swappable galvo modules
moduleSystem.description: One enclosed T1 chassis accepts Creality diode (20W/40W), fiber (20W), MOPA (60W), and UV (5W) modules: install one head at a time.

editorialDepth.advantages: The 60W MOPA module is Creality's top metal head for T1: pulse control for color stainless and faster deep marks than the 20W fiber option on the same chassis.
editorialDepth.limitations: Premium module pricing on top of chassis and likely earlier diode purchases. Overkill for occasional metal gifts. Galvo field size still limits large panels.

faq.question: What does the MOPA module add over the fiber module?
faq.answer: Adjustable pulse width. It lets you produce colour marks on stainless, black marks on anodised aluminium and cleaner marks on plastics, and its 60W output engraves deeper and faster. A deep 10 × 10 cm logo on stainless took about 1–3 min in our benchmark.

faq.question: How much does the T1 MOPA cost, and is it available?
faq.answer: On Creality's US store in October 2026: $4,299 for the T1 with the MOPA module, $2,699 for the module alone. The standalone module was on pre-order, listed as available from 20 October 2026.

faq.question: Is the MOPA worth $1,600 more than the fiber bundle?
faq.answer: Only if colour marking or deep metal engraving is paid work, for example custom knives, tags or jewellery. For logos and serial numbers the 20W fiber module does the same job for less.

standoutFeatures.title: Colour on stainless
standoutFeatures.body: Adjustable pulse width lets the MOPA source produce oxide colours on stainless steel, which a standard fiber source cannot do.

standoutFeatures.title: Deep metal engraving
standoutFeatures.body: The 60W output removes material quickly: a deep 10 × 10 cm logo on stainless took about 1–3 min in our benchmark.
